Time Signature: 3/4

This is hymn number 340 titled "The Star-Spangled Banner" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in B-flat Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by John Stafford Smith and the lyrics were written by Francis Scott Key.
